title: Run Record
description: One agentic run: a model × task × adapter combination, plus the full transcript and optional pre-computed alignment metadata. Emitted by run.py; consumed by the alignment engine, the web viewer, and bench.sh tabulation.

run_id.description: Content-addressed hash of inputs: task + model + adapter + seed + tool_versions + prompt_versions. Same hash = same trace = cache hit per D6.

model.description: Short model name. Resolves to OpenRouter slug via harness/agent.py:MODEL_SLUGS.

adapter.description: Adapter applied. 'passthrough' = no reshaping; named adapters apply per-model post-training compensations.

seed.description: RNG seed for deterministic re-execution. Null when temperature > 0 or no seeding pathway available.

tool_versions.description: Version stamp per tool name. Folds into run_id hash so tool changes invalidate cache.

prompt_versions.description: Version stamp per prompt component (system, task spec). Folds into run_id hash.

elapsed_s.description: Wall-clock seconds from agent.run start to completion or exception.

completed.description: Eval verdict — did the agent satisfy the task's structural correctness checks.

tool_calls.description: Count of successful tool calls in the transcript.

errors.description: Count of tool errors + agent errors.

loops.description: Heuristic count of repeated identical tool calls (≥3 of same name+first-arg).

early_termination.description: True if the agent stopped without producing required outputs (the Kimi failure mode signature).

agent_error.description: Top-level exception caught in run.py, formatted as 'Type: message'. Null on clean termination.

agent_error_detail.description: Structured form of the top-level error when extractable: exception type, HTTP status, provider, request id, response body. Reconstructed by walking __cause__/__context__ chain.

body.description: Raw error body from the provider (dict, str, or null).

response_text.description: Truncated HTTP response text when available.

agent_error_traceback.description: Full Python traceback for the top-level exception. Captured unconditionally — not just under --verbose.

transcript.description: Full transcript translated from smolagents memory. Required for alignment, step cards, and the lane view.

alignment.description: Pre-computed alignment metadata. Null until the aligner runs (C1.1); populated by C1.3.

column_map.description: One entry per transcript step, mapping step_idx → alignment column.

anchor_hits.description: Which anchors fired and at which transcript step.

content.description: Free-text content. Assistant: model output. Tool: result body. User: task spec or follow-up. System: instructions.

tool_calls.description: Present only on assistant messages that issue tool calls.

name.description: Tool name. Present on role=tool messages.

tool_call_id.description: Correlates a role=tool message back to its assistant tool_call by id.

id.description: Smolagents-assigned call id; correlates with role=tool tool_call_id.

name.description: Tool name. One of: fs_read, fs_write, fs_list, web_search, codegen_run, final_answer.

arguments.description: Raw arguments as the model emitted them.

signature.description: Canonical signature from harness/signature.py. Stable under cosmetic variation. Used for anchor matching and equivalent-tier alignment.

column_id.description: Stable id for the alignment column. Anchor columns: 'anchor:<anchor_id>'. Free columns: 'free:<sequence>'.

tier.description: Confidence tier from D3. Only meaningful in free columns matched cross-lane.

step_idx.description: Step where this anchor fired. Null if not satisfied.

count.description: How many times this anchor's signature appeared (for count-constrained anchors).
